frequency_question: How often does the U.S. Department of Education complete a full statutory de-recognition proceeding resulting in formal termination within a 49-day calendar window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal administrative agency proceedings targeting recognized accrediting bodies under the Higher Education Act; excludes voluntary relinquishments or minor probationary warnings without revocation orders.
provenance_note: 3 cases named, 5 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.7x); rate of 0% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major review processes; 0 completed within a 49-day statutory timeframe.
known_gaps: Minor advisory committee recommendations that did not reach final secretarial order are excluded.
skeleton: Total administrative de-recognition cycles initiated since the 1992 Higher Education Act amendments involving major national accreditors, multiplied by the fraction resulting in final revocation within 49 days.
multiplier: 0 completed fast-track revocations within 49 days out of ~5 major multi-year de-recognition attempts.
validity_reason: Administrative procedure statutes and Department of Education regulations governing recognition reviews remain stable across multi-year cycles.
